status: R1861 proves the complete abstract small-class/small-cut labeling theorem for a finite measure supported on COUNTABLY many invertible affine return graphs, with only a bounded source marginal. It constructs one actual measurable natural-valued label satisfying the original PiecewiseConstOn condition, arbitrarily small label classes and arbitrarily small total cut. Finite affine sets, mesh, collision, priority and countable-tail choices are all discharged. The original paths-to-return-measure bridge and quantitative exceptional-time endpoint remain. Four of six original families formalized; final referees pending.
